scripts.test:rules: PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk@21 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-building-ledger "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:phone-auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-building-ledger "VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_ALLOW_LEGACY_EMAIL_LOGIN=false VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-test-key VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=localhost VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-building-ledger VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-building-ledger.firebasestorage.app VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=0 VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo-test-app FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 vitest run tests/integration/phone-auth.test.ts"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
